description.value: Loon Fong Hotpot is an authentic Hong Kong-style hotpot restaurant in Richmond, BC, part of a small multi-location chain with outposts in Ontario. Diners cook fresh ingredients in flavourful broths tableside, following traditional Hong Kong recipes. It is located in a commercial plaza on busy Number 3 Road, a major cycling corridor in Richmond.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 58m; rack at 94m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at loonfong.ca confirms the Richmond BC location at 4540 Number 3 Rd #1200 and phone (778) 297-7881, matching OSM tags. The site has an 'Order Now' button indicating takeout is offered. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenity fields, so those remain null. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Loon Fong Hotpot' while the website headers and page titles consistently use 'Lung Fung Hot Pot'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Loon Fong Hotpot' but the website consistently uses 'Lung Fung Hot Pot' in page titles and headers; both spellings appear on the site, suggesting the romanisation is unstable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by website and a recent OSM check date of 2026-03-09; useful stop for touring cyclists on the Number 3 Road corridor.

wow_evidence: small multi-location chain with outposts in Ontario
